constrained_violations.claim: The holy place was lit by the golden lampstand (candlestick), not by ad-hoc hanging lamps.
constrained_violations.actual: The scene is lit by multiple hanging oil lamps on chains, not the seven-branched golden lampstand.

notes: Linen + mitre correct (specified ok); Aaron alone at the veil; the veil is a dark embroidered curtain, not plain white (ok). The contradiction is the lighting: hanging oil lamps are shown as the light source instead of the golden lampstand.
